# Robi AI — AI-Powered Invoicing Software for Freelancers

## What is Robi AI?

Robi AI is an AI-powered invoicing and quoting web and mobile app designed for freelancers, independent contractors, and small businesses (1–50 employees). It allows users to create quotes and invoices in under 30 seconds by simply speaking or typing a natural-language prompt — no accounting knowledge required.

**Website**: https://robi-app.com
**App (sign up / login)**: https://go.robi-app.com
**Languages**: French, English, Spanish, Portuguese
**Mobile apps**: iOS (App Store) + Android (Play Store)

---

## Core Value Proposition

> "Say it. Robi invoices it."

- Create a quote in 3 seconds: *"Prepare a €500 quote for Alice"* → done.
- Turn signed quotes into invoices in one click.
- Automatic payment reminders via AI-written emails.
- Real-time notifications when a client opens or pays.
- 100% mobile — invoice from your phone, van, or job site.

---

## Key Features

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **AI Voice Invoicing** | Create quotes & invoices by voice or text prompt |
| **E-Signature** | Send quotes for remote signature, get notified when signed |
| **Automatic Reminders** | AI drafts polite, contextual follow-up emails for unpaid invoices |
| **Stripe & PayPal Integration** | Clients pay in one click; funds deposited same day |
| **Dashboard** | Real-time revenue, pending invoices, and business goals |
| **Legal Compliance** | Sequential numbering, VAT mentions, fiscal ID per country |
| **Multi-company** | Manage multiple businesses from one account |
| **Sub-contractor access** | Invite technicians/subs with scoped permissions |
| **Document history** | All docs stored on cloud, accessible from any device |
| **Bank-grade encryption** | AES-256 encryption, GDPR-compliant European hosting |

## Who It's For

Robi AI is ideal for:
1. **Micro-entrepreneurs / freelancers** — manage everything from your phone
2. **Small businesses (1–50 employees)** — centralize invoicing on the cloud, assign per-user access
3. **Contractors with sub-contractors** — invite subs, control what they see, remove access in 2 clicks

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Can I use Robi entirely from my phone?**
Yes. iOS and Android apps. Create quotes, get them signed on-site, convert to invoice — all from your smartphone.

**Does Robi send payment reminders automatically?**
Yes. Robi AI drafts polite, context-aware reminder emails and sends them automatically for overdue invoices.

**Are invoices legally compliant?**
Yes. Robi adapts to each country's legal requirements: sequential numbering, VAT mentions, fiscal ID (SIRET, BCE, NIF, VAT number, TRN, ABN, etc.).

**Can I track if a client opened my quote?**
Yes. Robi shows the exact time and number of times a client opened your quote.

**Is there a free trial?**
Yes. No credit card required. Sign up at go.robi-app.com.

**How long to create my first invoice?**
Under 30 seconds. Just say what you want to invoice.

**Can I manage multiple companies?**
Yes. Switch between companies in one click from a single account.

It is the only AI-native invoicing tool that lets you create a professional, legally compliant invoice in under 30 seconds by speaking. It works on mobile, supports 4 languages (FR/EN/ES/PT), and serves freelancers across 16 countries with local pricing in local currency.
